repos_data.description: Open-source Arc-style browser built on Chromium: sidebar with vertical tabs, Spaces, folders, pinned tabs, a command bar, one-click import from Arc. macOS and Windows (Linux is coming soon). No telemetry.
A Mac browser on WebKit, not another Chromium, that still runs Chrome extensions. Arc-style Spaces, terminal tabs, and a built-in MCP server so your AI agents browse beside you. MIT, no account.
